OpenTelemetry.// Mode: Otlp exports to the conventional localhost collector endpoint when one listens; the app boots fine without a collector (see the README).

OpenIdConnect.// ClientSecret: An obvious placeholder for the local-only demo identity provider on 5310 — never a real credential. Real secrets come from KeyVault / environment / user-secrets, never appsettings.json.
OpenIdConnect.// RequireAuthenticatedEndpoints: false keeps the home page anonymous so the app boots gracefully without peers (AC-DR3); /whoami opts back in with [Authorize].

DemoApi.//: The user-flagged typed client: the signed-in user's token is what reaches the Api demo host on 5330.
